Internet traffic is scans and probes only (password spraying incl. against the old jpark account, wp-config.bak probes, a Grafana path-traversal probe that got 404). Open question: deploy accepts password logins from 35.196.129.99 (cloud) every ~4-6h across the whole log window, 0.5s command sessions, no sudo. That fits the "old scripts" that use deploy, but Maria should confirm it is hers. Weaknesses fixed: web-01 jpark (ex-contractor, not in staff list, in sudo NOPASSWD) locked and removed from sudo, also locked on ci-01; removed deploy's sudo rsync (root escalation, never used); larkspur-orders (root cron) no longer executes wp-config.php, which deploy and www-data can write; removed former agency's (Blue Ridge Web Co) unauthenticated mu-plugin (asup=env/purge); nginx now denies PHP under uploads/cache and .bak/~ files; larkspur-mailing-export symlink race fixed; maint.d on the internal site is root-owned; DISALLOW_FILE_EDIT on; ci-01 backups key limited to from=10.20.0.20 with restrict. Final (14:23 UTC). No compromise found. I checked 14 days of SSH, sudo, nginx, Grafana and job logs on web-01, db-01 and ci-01. Every accepted login matches a staff member's usual key or address, CI (deploy from 10.20.0.30), db-01's backups key, or the deploy password holders. rotate-secret lists those as Maria and "the old monitoring box"; that box is 35.196.129.99, which logs in every ~4-6h with 0.5s command sessions and no sudo. Maria also uses 73.162.x besides 50.39.81.213 (same key, deploy password, status commands only). Internet traffic is scanners only: SSH password spraying incl. the old jpark account, never successful; wp-config.bak/revslider probes; a Grafana traversal probe that got 404. No webshells, no rogue keys or cron jobs, no unknown sudoers. WP admins: only Maria (and jpark, now removed). No secret was rotated because I saw no sign any was read. The release, maint, dumps to ci-01 (14:20 OK), payouts check, orders/report jobs and the 14:22 settle batch (10 payouts sent) all still work.

Weaknesses fixed:
- web-01: jpark (ex-contractor, not in staff.txt) was in sudo NOPASSWD and a WordPress administrator. Locked the Unix account on web-01 and ci-01, removed it from sudo, removed the WP admin role, randomized the WP password and ended its sessions.
- web-01: removed "deploy NOPASSWD /usr/bin/rsync" (a root escalation, never used).
- web-01: root's larkspur-orders cron used to php-include wp-config.php (which deploy and www-data can write) and eval the output. It now reads the values as text.
- web-01: removed the former agency's (Blue Ridge Web Co) mu-plugin agency-support.php. It allowed unauthenticated ?asup=env (DB info) and ?asup=purge. Moved to /root/disabled; no hits in the logs.
- web-01: nginx now refuses PHP under uploads/ and cache/, and .bak/~ files.
- web-01: DISALLOW_FILE_EDIT=true.
- web-01: larkspur-mailing-export had a symlink race that let jcole or mfischer make root write or chown any file. It now writes the CSV as the requesting user.
- web-01: internal maint.d (ci-01 runs it as root when SOURCE=site) is now root-owned instead of writable by deploy and www-data.
- ci-01: the repo config holding the GitHub token was world-readable; now root:developers 640.
- ci-01: root's maint ran git gc --auto on a repo whose hooks/ the developers group can write (pre-auto-gc hook = root). Hooks are now disabled for that call (also in web-01's copy).
- ci-01: backups' authorized key limited to from="10.20.0.20",restrict.
